understood_functions.name: APU_ResolveBlockPointer
understood_functions.notes:
Exact static routine maps block ID X onto the packed audio-record pool beginning at `10:8000`. It walks X length-prefixed records, performing LoROM bank-wrap arithmetic, and returns the selected record pointer in DP `$63-$65`. Package-table IDs `$00-$31` address the first 50 records, but direct setup calls pass IDs through at least `$42`; the same contiguous parser resolves records `$32-$42`. Therefore `$00-$31` is the package-table ID universe, not the resolver's upper bound. |
| `02:8298` (USA) | `APU_TransferStateInit` | 5 | Exact retail bytes `PHP; SEP #$20; STZ $68; REP #$20; STZ $6C; STZ $6A; PLP; RTS` end at `02:82A4`. `02:8294` is a `JSR $8298; RTL` long-call wrapper. This corrects the earlier over-broad transfer label at `$8298`. |
| `02:82A5` (USA) | `APU_StreamTransfer_Wrapper` | 5 | Exact retail bytes are `JSR $82A9; RTL`. Twelve direct long-call sites target this wrapper; several load X immediately beforehand with clustered bank-03 source seeds including `$FAD5`, `$FB15`, `$FB55`, `$FBD5`, and `$FC15`. |
| `02:82A9` (USA) | `APU_StreamTransfer` | 4 | The body initializes `$6F`, stores X at DP `$83`, reads `LDA $030000,X`, and flows into the runtime-proven `$2142/$2143` transport loop at `02:82F0-02:8327`. First-race WRAM traces begin with paired `$83/$84 = $55/$FB` at frame 906, exactly corroborating the static `$FB55` caller seed. The earlier port trace reconstructs APU RAM `$B0E0-$BDE0` exactly.

understood_functions.name: Text_HandleFCPositionControl
understood_functions.notes: Bounded static analysis of the Sayans translation-control grammar. The routine preserves A, recognizes low-byte `FC`, consumes the following parameter, scans subsequent character bytes until `FF` or `FB`, consults `Text_TestCharacterMetadataBit7` for ordinary bytes, then computes `parameter * 32 + horizontal adjustment` into DP `$9F`. The 32-column arithmetic and translated `FF FC xx` / `FB FC xx` sequences support a centered tilemap-position/layout role. Exact user-facing meaning of the parameter remains unpromoted.

understood_functions.name: Text_TestCharacterMetadataBit7
understood_functions.notes: Shared helper reached from four text/layout loops including `03:8998`, `00:C4CB`, and `00:C510`. It indexes the byte table at `00:C6F8` by character code and tests bit 7. Printable-table inspection shows uppercase A-Z in the low half while lowercase a-z, digits and much punctuation usually carry bit 7; therefore this is a verified character-metadata class test, not yet a proven glyph-width flag.
